description: Compute gross and net rental yield from purchase price, monthly rent and annual expenses.

faqs.a: Gross yield = annual rent ÷ purchase price. Net yield = (annual rent − annual expenses) ÷ purchase price. Net yield reflects real cash return before financing.
Include taxes, insurance, maintenance, vacancy allowance, property management and HOA — everything except mortgage payments.
A good yield depends on the market: 4–6% is typical in expensive cities, 8%+ in cheaper rental markets. Always compare net yields, not gross.
